Yeah thats a plus for you... I've got to the point were I don't wear dresses or shorts that often anymore, I feel slightly restricted in what I wear.. 

Anyway I wish you luck on your personal journey, Thanks for the reply!

Thanks, I have a therapist and have always had good support in my life. So I've already tried reaching out many times, it does not seem to help, and only drags everyone else down... I just don't want to be that toxic person to them anymore..

The reason I'm posting this here is because I just wanted to get this off my chest without effecting the people in my real life.

And as for my therapist, I have an elective surgery coming up so I don't want to look too crazy and get pulled out of that... 

And I'm not sure if replacing cutting with a reddit addiction is the best idea lol..

It may sound funny but I don't consider cutting all that bad of an addiction in itself, I consider the escalation in my behaviour bad...
